items.title: Grace Must Be Free
items.summary: If you treated your salvation no longer as a gift, but as a purchase, God would no longer be the free benefactor.

items.title: How to Repay God
items.summary: You can’t give anything to God or do anything for God that he hasn’t first given to you and done for you.

items.title: God-Given Foes and God-Given Faith
items.summary: Fear not. Your adversaries can do no more than God grants. And he will grant you the faith you need. Those are gospel promises.

items.title: Present and Powerful Love
items.summary: Nothing will separate us from the love of Christ because Christ is alive and is still loving us right now.

items.title: The Goal of Christ’s Love
items.summary: God loves us so much that he will not allow our preciousness to become our god.

items.title: What’s New About the New Covenant
items.summary: In the old covenant, the gracious enabling power to obey God was not poured out as fully as it is since Jesus.

items.title: The “I Will” of God
items.summary: If you feel vulnerable, you can say to God, “Lord, help me. I’m not even sure how to pray.” Trust that he will respond and will help you.

items.title: Daily Vigilance for Lifelong Productivity
items.summary: Daily productivity requires often elusive focus and grit. Pastor John offers ten charges to live each day to the glory of God.

items.title: Why Did Jesus Call Her a Dog?
items.summary: Did Jesus demean the Canaanite woman he called a dog? Pastor John explains how Jesus’s test revealed her great faith — and her adoption as one of God’s own.

items.title: When Walking Away Feels Good
items.summary: Why should we follow Jesus when life seems easier without him? Pastor John responds to a man questioning the cost of daily obedience.

items.title: How a Crushed Faith Comes Home
items.summary: Deep suffering can drive us away from true hope and comfort. But our Father waits to gather us back to himself.

items.title: When Nice People Face God
items.summary: Does eternal punishment in hell bring God glory? Pastor John challenges the rejection of God’s judgment by pointing to his unmerited mercies and perfect righteousness.

items.title: Can My Silence Cost Souls?
items.summary: Why does evangelism matter when God has chosen whom he will save? Pastor John unpacks and rejoices in our role as God’s instruments.
